_help: Edited by hand when news breaks; the collector never touches it. 'copyable' turns true once there's a public way to copy (dump) GTA 6 off a PS5, which emulators need before anyone can test it. 'routes' lists every way to get GTA 6 onto a PC and 'players' the people and groups working on each; status is works, partial or blocked. Keep every claim sourced, say 'reported' for anything Rockstar or Sony hasn't confirmed, and never link to exploits, payloads, jailbreak tools or game files: cite news coverage instead.
copy_blocker: GTA 6 needs PS5 firmware 14.23, which Sony released on November 17, and there's no public way to copy games off a PS5 on any 14.xx firmware: public exploits stop at 13.60. Days before launch the PS5 hacker Gezine said he had dumped an unnamed game on 14.22, one version older, but he hasn't shown proof or shared how.
firmware: Sony confirmed that GTA 6 needs PS5 system software 26.07-14.23.00, released on November 17, 2026; its notes list only security fixes. The pre-load package had listed 14.22, and earlier builds 14.10.
pc_version: Rockstar hadn't announced a PC version by launch day. GamesBeat reports one for early 2027, citing four industry sources.

TweakTown: Gezine claims a game dump on firmware 14.22

routes.title: Remote Play from your own console
routes.label: Works today
routes.text: Rockstar says GTA 6 fully supports Remote Play. With your own PS5 or Xbox Series X|S and a copy of the game, Sony's PS Remote Play app, the Xbox app or the open-source chiaki-ng client streams it to a Windows PC. The game still runs on the console, at its 30 fps.

routes.title: Remote Play with frame generation
routes.label: Works, with lag
routes.text: SmoovPlay, a free open-source PC app built on chiaki-ng, adds AI-generated frames to the Remote Play stream on your graphics card, turning 30 fps into 60 to 120. It adds roughly 20 to 36 ms of delay, and the game still responds like 30 fps. Its GTA 6 demo used trailer footage, not the game running on a PS5.

source.name: TweakTown: SmoovPlay turns 30 fps console streams into 120 fps

routes.title: Cloud streaming
routes.label: Xbox consoles only
routes.text: Rockstar's November 10 announcement puts GTA 6 on Xbox Cloud Gaming for Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One only. Xbox's chief strategy officer, Matthew Ball, said it won't stream to PC. It isn't on GeForce Now or PlayStation Plus cloud streaming either.

source.name: Shacknews: Xbox clarifies GTA 6 won't stream on PC

routes.title: An official PC version
routes.label: Not announced
routes.text: Rockstar hadn't announced one by launch day, and Take-Two's CEO, Strauss Zelnick, says that news will come from Rockstar. GamesBeat reported on October 13 that a PC version is planned for early 2027, citing four industry sources. GTA V took about 19 months to reach PC.

source.name: Insider Gaming: GTA 6 PC news will come from Rockstar, says Take-Two

routes.title: PS5 emulation
routes.label: Needs a copy first
routes.text: AnyPS5, KytyPS5 and SharpEmu can only test games copied (dumped) off a PS5, and nobody can copy GTA 6 yet: it needs firmware 14.23, and public exploits stop at 13.60. GTA V's PS5 version, on the same RAGE engine, already gets in-game on KytyPS5 and SharpEmu, and AnyPS5's testers report playing its opening mission.

source.name: AnyPS5 on GitHub: Grand Theft Auto V test thread

routes.title: A fan-made native port
routes.label: Needs a copy first
routes.text: Since October, fans have rebuilt PlayStation games such as Bloodborne and Astro Bot to run natively on PC, each starting from a copy dumped off a console. GTA 6 would need the same dump. Take-Two has also fought fan rebuilds before: it had re3 and reVC, rebuilds of GTA III and Vice City, taken down in 2021 and sued their makers.

routes.title: Xbox emulation
routes.label: No emulator exists
routes.text: No emulator runs Xbox Series X|S or Xbox One games on PC. Microsoft's own PC backward compatibility, launched in 2026, covers only original Xbox and Xbox 360 games.

source.name: Android Authority: Microsoft launches Xbox backward compatibility on PC

players.name: AnyPS5 and its GTA V testers
players.text: AnyPS5, started by boykopovar in August 2026, relinks PS5 games to run on the PC's own processor. Its compatibility list has GTA V at the menus, but testers in its GTA V thread report more: MichonGoddijn231849 played the North Yankton prologue at 27 to 28 fps on a test branch, mrfelek reached the bank scene on the main build on Linux on November 14, and LeonardoS11 measured 16.3 fps there on Windows on November 16. simnJS's AnyKyty branch pairs it with KytyPS5's graphics code.

players.name: KytyPS5
players.text: A PS5 translation layer built on Kyty, an emulator last developed in 2022. It gets the most games in-game, 310 on its list, GTA V among them. Contributors such as TheCruZ are working on a crash in GTA V's prologue.

players.name: SharpEmu
players.text: An experimental PS5 emulator, run by its community since July 15, 2026, with the most games marked fully playable: 47. GTA V's PS5 version gets in-game.

players.name: Gezine
players.text: A leading PS5 jailbreak developer. Reported a kernel exploit for firmware 14.10 in October, and on November 16 said he had dumped an unnamed game on 14.22. He hasn't shown proof or shared how, and Sony shipped 14.23 the next day.

players.name: Echo Stretch
players.text: Replied to Gezine that the 14.22 dump needed no hypervisor exploit, the protection the scene thought still stood in the way. Unconfirmed, and other reports read Gezine's post differently.

players.name: ntfargo (Relapse)
players.text: Published Relapse on September 29, a jailbreak for PS5 firmware 7.00 to 13.60. It doesn't reach the 14.23 firmware GTA 6 needs.

players.name: PS5Dev (Byepervisor-Reborn)
players.text: Released a hypervisor exploit for firmware 13.20 and 13.60 on October 12, a base for developers rather than a jailbreak for players. It also stops short of GTA 6's firmware.

players.name: deadinside28 (bbport)
players.text: Released bbport on October 1, a native PC port of Bloodborne that started the wave of fan-rebuilt PlayStation games. Players need their own dumped copy.

players.name: The Astro Bot port
players.text: On November 13 a fan port of Astro Bot became the first PS5 game with a native PC build, showing the route works for PS5 games that can be dumped.

players.name: chiaki-ng
players.text: The open-source Remote Play client for PS4 and PS5, on Windows, Linux, macOS and Steam Deck. With your own console and copy, it's a legitimate way to play GTA 6 on a PC today.

players.name: SmoovPlay
players.text: A free open-source app released in November 2026 that adds AI frame generation to console Remote Play, from 30 fps up to 120, at the cost of extra input delay.

players.name: Rockstar Games and Take-Two
players.text: No PC version announced. Take-Two's CEO says that news will come from Rockstar; GamesBeat's sources point to early 2027.

players.name: Sony
players.text: Shipped two security updates in the run-up to launch, 14.22 on November 2 and 14.23 on November 17, and made 14.23 a requirement for GTA 6. Its notes list only security fixes.

players.name: Microsoft (Xbox)
players.text: Streams GTA 6 through Xbox Cloud Gaming to Xbox consoles only. Xbox's Matthew Ball said it won't stream to PC.
